description: Module 3: Nurse Acquisition Hub - A new /acquisition route with 4 track tabs (Organisations, Referral Network, Community Channels, Events) and a shared outreach pipeline. Each track shows sources with stats, and the pipeline shows leads progressing through contact stages.
steps: Create src/types/acquisition.ts with interfaces: AcquisitionSource (id, name, type: Organisation|Referral|Community|Event, contactPerson, contactEmail, status: Active|Prospective|Inactive, leadsGenerated, conversionRate, lastContact, notes), OutreachLead (id, sourceId, sourceName, nurseFullName, stage: Contacted|Interested|Applied|Converted|Lost, contactDate, followUpDate, notes)

Create src/lib/mock-acquisition.ts with mock data: 3-4 organisations (hospitals, nursing agencies), 3-4 referral partners, 3-4 community channels (WhatsApp groups, Facebook groups, forums), 3-4 events (career fairs, conferences). Also include 8-10 outreach leads at various pipeline stages.
Update src/lib/data.ts to add getAcquisitionSources(), getAcquisitionSourceById(id), and getOutreachLeads() async functions
Create src/store/acquisition-store.ts with Zustand store: activeTab (organisations|referral|community|events|pipeline), searchQuery, statusFilter
Create src/app/acquisition/page.tsx as a server component that calls getAcquisitionSources() and getOutreachLeads(), renders the AcquisitionHub client component
Create src/components/acquisition/AcquisitionHub.tsx ('use client') - main container with tab navigation (4 tracks + Pipeline tab), search bar, and content area

Create src/components/acquisition/SourceCard.tsx - a card for each acquisition source showing: name, type badge, contact person, leads generated count, conversion rate, status indicator, last contact date
Create src/components/acquisition/SourceGrid.tsx - renders a grid of SourceCards filtered by the active tab type

Create src/components/acquisition/OutreachPipeline.tsx - a kanban-style pipeline (or list grouped by stage) showing outreach leads: Contacted -> Interested -> Applied -> Converted. Each lead card shows nurse name, source, date, follow-up indicator.
Create src/components/acquisition/LeadCard.tsx - small card for a lead in the pipeline showing nurse name, source name, contact date, and status badge
Update src/components/sidebar.tsx to add Acquisition nav item (using Megaphone or Network icon from Lucide) after Cohorts
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
/acquisition route renders with 5 tabs (Organisations, Referral Network, Community Channels, Events, Pipeline)
Each track tab shows a grid of source cards with stats
Pipeline tab shows outreach leads grouped by stage (kanban or grouped list)
Styling matches existing patterns (propela-purple, card style, badge pattern)
verification: Run pnpm build and confirm zero errors
Run pnpm lint and confirm zero errors or only warnings
findings: Build and lint pass cleanly. All 5 tabs render. Pipeline uses kanban-style column layout with 5 stages. Used Megaphone icon from Lucide for sidebar. Filter chips use rounded-2xl pattern matching existing codebase style.
